verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has merge requests, its equivalent of pull requests: agents create them, findings appear in them, review instructions apply to them, and the GitHub importer carries pull requests over. Nothing in the pack documents forking a repository or outside contributors submitting merge requests from a fork back to the upstream project. missing for 10: documented repository forking, a fork-to-upstream merge request workflow for external contributors, contributor permission controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can let outside contributors fork my repository and propose changes back via pull requests

citations.quote: Agents turn issues into merge requests
